answer_1.quote: We pose the task of knowledge-constrained NPC dialogue generation ...
answer_1.outputs: dialogue trees (directed graphs) and individual utterances

answer_2.quote: We measure ... BLEU-4 scores ... BERTScore ... exact match and Jaccard overlap scores ... GPT-4 produced scores ...

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4 as a judge ... pairwise evaluation ... GPT-4 produced scores for coherence, violation, bio usage, quest usage ...

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation ... 100 generations per model were judged on a 4-point Likert scale for four criteria: Coherence, (Non-)Violation, Biography Usage, Quest Usage ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each utterance on a 4‑point Likert scale for Coherence, Violation, Biography Usage, and Quest Usage.
